name: 01-scan
sql: SELECT department_id,name FROM departments ORDER BY department_id

name: 02-key-lookup
sql: SELECT employee_id,name FROM employees WHERE employee_id=1

name: 03-two-table-join
sql: SELECT e.employee_id,d.name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id=e.department_id

name: 04-left-self-join
sql: SELECT e.employee_id,m.name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON m.employee_id=e.manager_id

name: 05-three-table-join
sql: SELECT o.order_id,c.name,e.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=o.sales_rep_id

name: 06-five-table-aggregate
sql: SELECT c.customer_id,e.name,p.name,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=o.sales_rep_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id,e.name,p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

name: 07-group-having-sort
sql: SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) AS n,SUM(total_amount) AS amount FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ORDER BY amount DESC

name: 08-distinct-join
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.region,p.product_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id

name: 09-correlated-exists
sql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND o.total_amount>0)

name: 10-correlated-not-exists
sql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND o.total_amount<0)

name: 11-in-subquery
sql: SELECT employee_id FROM employees WHERE department_id IN (SELECT department_id FROM departments WHERE department_id>0)

name: 12-scalar-subquery
sql: SELECT c.customer_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id) AS n FROM customers c

name: 13-derived-left-join
sql: SELECT c.customer_id,s.amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id,SUM(total_amount) AS amount FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id

name: 14-cte-window
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT employee_id,department_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC,employee_id) AS rn FROM employees) SELECT r.employee_id,d.name FROM ranked r JOIN departments d ON d.department_id=r.department_id WHERE r.rn=1

name: 15-union-all
sql: SELECT customer_id AS entity_id FROM customers WHERE customer_id<3 UNION ALL SELECT employee_id AS entity_id FROM employees WHERE employee_id<3 ORDER BY entity_id
